subject: Re: Short trial — packaging options and LOI vs SKU bundle
messages:
From: Samir Desai <samir@helixlabs.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
Cc: Kelly Tran <kelly.tran@helixlabs.ai>
Date: 2027-04-19T10:14:00-07:00
Subject: Short trial — packaging options and LOI vs SKU bundle

Kim,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the team was impressed with the latency profile and the cost transparency. We need to finalize how we structure the 30-day evaluation: race to production vs a time-boxed pilot with a small commitment. A couple of procurement questions before we loop legal:

- Would Redwood accept a short Letter of Intent (LOI) that documents scope and success metrics instead of a full addendum?
- If we go with a SKU bundle (burst pool + 24/7 support), can we get a one-time trial discount applied to that SKU rather than a duration extension?

We're also asking for a modest extension (3 extra business days) on the evaluation — engineering hit a blocker. Interested in what flexibility there is on packaging and price to bridge that.

Thanks,
Samir
Samir Desai
Head of ML Engineering, Helix Labs
--
Attachment: helix-demo-notes.pdf (preview only)

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
To: Samir Desai <samir@helixlabs.ai>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, Kelly Tran <kelly.tran@helixlabs.ai>
Date: 2027-04-19T13:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Short trial — packaging options and LOI vs SKU bundle

Samir —

Appreciate the clear asks. Quick answers up front, then options: we can do an LOI to lock scope + success metrics for the 30-day window (fast path) or an addendum amendment if legal needs that. For pricing: we can apply a trial discount to a SKU bundle, or offer a short-term credit that’s applied after conversion — both are common.

Options I recommend (pick one):
1) LOI + SKU bundle: 20% one-time trial discount on the bundle if you sign an LOI within 48 hours. No contract amendment needed for the 3-day runway bump.
2) Addendum + conditional extension: Add 3 business days, 15% discount, and a clause that credits the discount to first invoice on conversion.
3) Time-box with success-triggered discount: keep current SKU, add 3 days, and if success metrics are met we apply a 25% credit toward first month.

Jordan — can you confirm the support scope and burst pool sizing we discussed? Marcus — finance needs to confirm the approval window for a 25% conditional credit.

If that looks reasonable I'll attach a short LOI template and a redlined quote.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 415-555-0123
--
Attachments: redwood-quote-v2.pdf (quote), LOI-template-short.docx

Kim / Samir —

Quick technical note to help choose: if Helix wants the burst pool SKU, we should provision a 2x burst cap for the trial to avoid throttling during the eval. That means the bundle will include an extra 100 peak concurrent tokens buffer. Support scope: 24/7 incident response (P1) and one weekly sync. No changes needed to instrumentation.

If you go LOI path we can spin the burst pool within 24–36 hours of signed LOI.

Jordan
Sr. Solutions Engineer, Redwood

Kim / team,

Finance reviewed the three options. We can approve up to a 25% conditional credit applied to Helix's first invoice (not a cash discount) provided:
- There is an LOI or signed addendum specifying success metrics (min production QPS and data ingress thresholds).
- The LOI is signed within 72 hours of this email.
- Helix agrees to a 6-month conversion window (standard commit terms) for the credit to be applied.

If they prefer a one-time 20% discount without a conversion commitment, approvals take longer (legal + finance) and we cannot hold the price longer than 7 calendar days.

Happy to draft the finance clause for the LOI if you want.

Marcus Lin
Director, Revenue Operations, Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Short trial — packaging options and LOI vs SKU bundle

Samir —

Thanks — based on Marcus's note and Jordan's sizing, here's a concrete LOI offer for Helix Labs if you'd like to accept quickly:

- Scope: 30-day time-boxed evaluation starting on sign; add 3 business days as requested.
- Success metrics: 95th percentile latency < 220ms for production-like payloads and sustained 10k tokens/day ingestion during the window (we'll list test endpoints in the LOI).
- Commercials: conditional 25% credit applied to first invoice upon conversion (6-month minimum commit). Credit is not cash and expires if conversion does not occur within 90 days of the trial end.
- Operational: 2x burst pool provisioned; 24/7 P1 support during the trial.

If that matches your needs I will send: a short LOI (1 page), the redwood-quote-v2.pdf with the SKU bundle and burst sizing, and a mutual-action-plan.xlsx to capture milestones. Sign LOI within 72 hours to secure the conditional credit.

Kelly / procurement — let me know if you need a PO before LOI sign; we can accept a PO as acknowledgement of intent.

Looking forward to closing this out quickly.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
